schema_note: One window only, the plan's own. trip-windows/1 (overview spec 2.2) needs 2 to 4 windows, so this file keeps the same field names under trip-season-basic/1 and adds a `season` block in the adapter's Season shape.
months_basis_note: The plan's own months: the plan starts in the last week of July and ends in the second week of August.

sources.title: Climate normals 1991-2020 by station (normal value tables: tre2dymx, tre2dymn, rre150m0, rsd010m0)
sources.publisher: MeteoSwiss (Federal Office of Meteorology and Climatology)

points.name: MeteoSwiss station Luzern
points.note: LV95 2665544 / 1209849 from the normals table, converted to WGS84 with the swisstopo approximate formulas (about 1 m accuracy).

points.name: MeteoSwiss station Interlaken
points.note: LV95 2633042 / 1169069, converted as above. Valley stand-in for the Wengen base; Wengen itself has no normals station in the set.

points.name: MeteoSwiss station Jungfraujoch
points.note: High-altitude reference only; not used for sun times.

label.value: Last week of July to the second week of August

why.value: The plan's own fortnight in high summer: the warmest weeks in the mountains and the longest days, with frequent rain in the lake country.

tempC.value: 14 to 25 C at Lucerne and Interlaken, 8 to 20 C at Zermatt; just above or below 0 C on the Jungfraujoch
tempC.note: MeteoSwiss 1991-2020, mean daily min to max, July / August: Luzern 14.6/14.4 to 24.9/24.3; Interlaken 13.8/13.6 to 24.3/23.7; Zermatt 8.3/8.3 to 20.0/19.6; Jungfraujoch -2.1/-1.7 to 3.4/3.5.

rain.value: About 13 days with 1 mm or more a month at Lucerne and Interlaken, 9 to 10 at Zermatt
rain.note: July / August precipitation and days >= 1 mm: Luzern 165.5/170.0 mm, 12.7/12.7 days; Interlaken 145.8/145.8 mm, 12.8/12.8 days; Zermatt 58.9/68.4 mm, 9.0/9.8 days.

daylight.value: Sunrise about 06:00 to 06:20, sunset about 21:05 falling to 20:50; about 15 hours of day
daylight.note: core/bin/sun.ts for the first and last plan day: Luzern sunrise 05:59 to 06:16, sunset 21:08 to 20:49, day 15h09m to 14h32m; Zermatt sunrise 06:04 to 06:21, sunset 21:07 to 20:48, day 15h02m to 14h27m. Valley horizon not modelled.

notes.text: Zermatt is the driest base, with well under half the rain of Lucerne
Mean highs on the Jungfraujoch stay near 3 C even in high summer, so pack warm layers

windows.label: Last week of July to the second week of August
windows.verdict_note: Not set: only the plan's own window was researched in this batch. The trip's timing research compares it with other months but uses secondary sources for crowds.
windows.best_for: Long days on the high lifts and trails in the warmest weeks

plus.text: Warmest weeks at height: Zermatt afternoons near 20 C
Zermatt sees rain on fewer days than the lake bases

minus.text: July and August are the wettest months at Lucerne, about 170 mm each
Rain on about 13 days a month at Lucerne and Interlaken
Freezing nights on the Jungfraujoch even in high summer

unknown.tried: MeteoSwiss 1991-2020 normal value tables: no Wengen, Lauterbrunnen, Grindelwald or Murren station; Interlaken used as the valley stand-in.

unknown.text: Crowd level in this window from an official source
